text: I went there for dental check, I also done cleaning with polishing and technically 3 x small fillings, one from down tooth and 2 upper teeth (all teeth next to each other). Everything (dental check, cleaning, "3" x fillings in 45 minutes what can let you think already)... I felt that doctor done the filling only on down teeth and barely touched these 2 upper, he just used dentist drill to drill on the edges on these upper teeth for maybe 30 seconds all together probably thinking that this is going let me think that some work was done. I paid for everything (6000 all together) but felt that just get scammed and ripped off and these 2 upper teeth it was just reason to get more money from me (I paid 2400 for them) for nothing. If you can I would recommend try different dentist

The service was terrible. The dentist quoted me 4,000 baht for a filling. After the filling, my tooth had problems and smelled foul constantly. The dentist tried to solve the problem by having me remove the filling. Why would I pay for a filling if it's going to be removed and my tooth will be damaged in the process?
I'm really confused by the dentist's attitude, both the dentist and the assistant. They spoke to the customer as if I were asking for free dental treatment.

I was on holiday with my parents in Phuket. My tooth started hurting on the first day. The next day they put in a temporary filling. Everything was done professionally, the anesthesia was high-quality, it was sterile, and they removed it after 6 days. Both times were much better than in Russia.
